arms.CS: C + margin slope conditional on conference
arms.CST: CS + in-season team offence/defence effects (designated full arm)
arms.LEVEL: REFERENCE ONLY: one scoring-level constant (mechanism owned by cbb-edge-finder Waves 12/14)
arms.STRETCH: REFERENCE ONLY: margin slope alone (mechanism owned by Wave 15 A1)

design.contract_probabilities: P(D>k) = 1 - Phi((k-m)/margin_sd), k = 0 for winner; P(T>k) = 1 - Phi((k-t)/total_sd); incumbent reference = same formula on its own frozen means
design.headline_rule: headline rows = arms C/CS/CST margin and total NLL vs incumbent; CST moneyline Brier; CST Kalshi Brier vs incumbent and vs mid; CST abs error vs the ESPN line. Holm across headline rows; verdict_from(); other rows Bonferroni by the headline count
design.loss_metrics: normal negative log density of the realised margin / total with the FROZEN SDs (nats); absolute error; Brier (home win; Kalshi contracts)
design.penalties_rule: fixed a priori from prior scales (see module constants); never tuned; no grid was run
design.selection_disclosure: The STRUCTURE (conference effects, conditional slope) was chosen after full-sample descriptive regressions that include both cohorts; parameters are walk-forward but the choice of structure is not. The overall verdict is therefore capped at IMPROVED_NOT_VALIDATED.
design.walk_forward: slate-by-slate; training = earlier slates with the final first observed before the slate's first tip

wave_separation.untouched: no Wave 14-16 file, forecast, spec or result was read by this module, modified or re-run; the sample ends before the Waves 15-16 window opens
wave_separation.wave14: pw-level-0.5.0-v1 shifts the pure-0.5.0 TOTAL by beta*prior_weight*possessions on records from 2026-11-11T22:00Z; margin untouched. Here: no level term, no prior-weight input, base pure-0.2.0; the LEVEL reference arm is reported only to show what a level explains and is owned by Waves 12/14.
wave_separation.wave15: A1 stretches the pure-0.5.0 margin by one walk-forward slope; A2 rescales margin SD by |margin|; window opens 2026-11-15. Here: the slope is estimated jointly with conference effects (walk-forward value in studies.walk_forward_last_slate), SDs are frozen; the STRETCH reference arm is Wave 15's mechanism on another base and is never a headline row.
wave_separation.wave16: rcenter-0.5.0r-v1 removes the roster overlay's mean margin offset; window opens 2026-11-15. Here: no roster-overlay record is read and no global margin intercept is fitted.

input_stage_claims.evidence: Arm C (conference effects): margin NLL 3.9628 vs 3.9637, diff -0.0009 [-0.0132, +0.0128], p_holm 1.000, replicated False, INCONCLUSIVE (n=544); total NLL 4.2467 vs 4.2606, diff -0.0139 [-0.0300, +0.0018], p_holm 0.830, replicated True, INCONCLUSIVE (n=544).

Arm CST (conference + conditional slope + team effects): margin NLL 3.9642 vs 3.9637, diff +0.0005 [-0.0136, +0.0155], p_holm 1.000, replicated False, INCONCLUSIVE (n=544); total NLL 4.2471 vs 4.2606, diff -0.0135 [-0.0295, +0.0025], p_holm 0.830, replicated True, INCONCLUSIVE (n=544); vs ESPN line margin abs err 9.9718 vs 9.0074, diff +0.9645 [+0.6045, +1.3099], p_holm 0.007, replicated True, NOT_IMPROVED (n=544).
Arm CS (conditional slope): margin NLL 3.9637 vs 3.9637, diff +0.0000 [-0.0132, +0.0150], p_holm 1.000, replicated False, INCONCLUSIVE (n=544).

limitations: 544 games over 13 slates of one November; early-season non-conference play only (2 same-conference games), so conference effects are identified from cross-conference games and will be re-learned differently once league play starts.

The model structure was selected after full-sample descriptive regressions (both cohorts). Walk-forward protects the parameters, not the choice of structure; treat every favourable row as exploratory until a prospective, preregistered run confirms it.
SDs are the frozen ones: a better mean with an unchanged SD slightly understates the challenger's density gain and leaves calibration to the incumbent.
Tempo versus efficiency uses box-score possessions for Nov 1-9 only (owner's committed Wave 12 table); later games have no possession count in any committed archive.

The ESPN line is one book's free line captured by the owner (rights unresolved; benchmark only). Kalshi quotes are latest pre-tip snapshots; mids are not executable; fees not modelled; nothing here is a profitability claim.
No multi-season game-level lake is committed, so none of this can be checked on earlier Novembers; see research/data_foundation_ops/CBB/MULTISEASON_GAME_DATA_SPEC.md.
Games against non-Division-I opponents have no frozen projection and are outside the sample.

coverage.note: games with a verified final but no pure-0.2.0 record (mostly Division I against non-Division-I opponents) are never projected, so a D1-versus-non-D1 error cannot be measured from this archive

home_court.note: const = what is left of home court at a zero projected margin on true home-site games; an interval covering 0 = no detectable mis-sizing

margin.tier_note: ph / lh = (home is power) - (away is power) / (home is low-major) - (away is low-major). Power = ['Atlantic Coast Conference', 'Southeastern Conference', 'Big Ten Conference', 'Big 12 Conference', 'Big East Conference']; mid = ['Atlantic 10 Conference', 'Mountain West Conference', 'American Conference', 'West Coast Conference', 'Missouri Valley Conference']; low = every other conference.

studies.note: Descriptive, full sample, NOT used for forecasting. Residual = actual - frozen pure-0.2.0; gap = ESPN pre-tip line - model (home frame); market residual = actual - line. Intervals: pairs bootstrap over games.

overtime.note: overtime games sit far above the frozen total; the regulation-only residual is the part of the level error that is not overtime (whether the frozen total includes an expected-overtime allowance is not stated in the record)

tempo_efficiency.note: exact split on the games with box-score possessions in the owner's research/wave12/wave12_game_table.csv (Nov 1-9): pace = (actual - projected possessions) x projected points per possession; efficiency = the rest

verdict.reason: 15 headline pooled comparisons (Holm): {'VALIDATED_IMPROVEMENT': 0, 'IMPROVED_NOT_VALIDATED': 0, 'INCONCLUSIVE': 12, 'NOT_IMPROVED': 3, 'REJECTED': 0}. Structure chosen on full-sample diagnostics, so the overall verdict cannot exceed IMPROVED_NOT_VALIDATED; one season, 13 slates.
